fusions.name: Rivet Popper
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 32 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Breastplate
fusions.desc: Strikes your own plating, and the ring deals 7 resonating damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Also costs 3% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Dents Beaten Out
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Smithy-Made Harness
fusions.desc: Conjures hammered plate over you: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your maximum health rises by 8, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
